lessons.title: Business value of Microsoft Power Platform
lessons.summary: Understand how Power Platform creates business value with apps, automation, Dataverse, connectors, websites, agents, and Copilot-assisted creation.
learningObjectives: Describe how Power Platform creates apps, automations, sites, and agents
Identify Dataverse and connectors as shared data integration pieces
Explain how Copilot assists makers in building solutions
Choose a Power Platform service for a basic business need
lessons.explanation: A stuck spreadsheet is often where Power Platform begins. **Power Apps** builds custom business apps, **Power Automate** automates processes, **Microsoft Dataverse** organizes shared business data, **connectors** integrate Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, Azure, and external services, **Power Pages** creates external business websites, and **Copilot Studio** creates agents. Low-code lets business experts build useful solutions while professional developers extend them with APIs, custom connectors, and Azure services. Copilot features can draft apps, flows, tables, and agent topics, but people still validate business fit, security, accessibility, and data policies.

terminology.definition: Visual development with less handwritten code.
A wrapper around an API used by apps, flows, and agents.
Business and developer roles building together.
AI assistance for drafting or changing solution assets.

lessons.businessScenario: Tailwind Traders replaces email-based equipment requests with Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, connectors, and a Copilot Studio help agent.
lessons.technicalExample: A canvas app writes Equipment Request rows to Dataverse, a flow sends Outlook approvals, and a custom connector calls a legacy inventory API.

misconception.myth: Power Platform is only for tiny personal tools.
misconception.reality: It can start small but supports environments, roles, data policies, ALM, and developer extensibility.

lessons.examTakeaway: Apps suggest Power Apps, process steps suggest Power Automate, structured shared data suggests Dataverse, external sites suggest Power Pages, and conversational assistants suggest Copilot Studio.
lessons.recap: Power Platform combines low-code services, connectors, Dataverse, AI assistance, and governance to create business solutions faster.
lessons.simplerExplanation: Think of a workshop: apps are tools, Dataverse is the cabinet, connectors are adapters, automation is the conveyor belt, and governance is the safety checklist.
lessons.anotherExample: A school could use Power Pages for a parent portal, Dataverse for cases, Power Automate for routing, and Copilot Studio for FAQs.

flashcards.back: Integrate services without writing every API call.

knowledgeCheck.explanation: Power Apps is the right starting point because the need is an interactive custom business app, while Dataverse and connectors provide shared data and integrations.
